update.releaseNotes:
v5.9.67 - Analytics tab, debug API endpoints, support card automation removal
New --- - Added an Analytics tab to the remote log viewer: bar charts for Training Distribution, Race Results, Mood Recovery, and Energy Recovery, plus line charts for Stat Growth, Energy, and Fans over time. - Added /debug-images and /debug-images/{filename} endpoints to the remote log viewer's API for listing and downloading the bot's debug screenshots. - Added a /decisions endpoint that extracts per-turn Decision Report blocks from the message log as structured JSON.
Removed ------- - Removed the on-device support-card borrow/equip automation (auto-borrow support card, auto-equip owned support deck, and the opt-in Career Planner deck-bias feature). Parent Farming's deck scoring and recommendation logic is unchanged, but borrowing/equipping support cards during a run now requires manual action.
